cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It can't say yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. As venue manager, will you approve storing Tuesday's rain in this cup? The wedding needs a dry lawn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tuesday hasn't happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing supporting it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Time doesn't fit in jars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never seen it either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The soup followed the spoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.
